build.command: npm run build via npm run e2e

standard_e2e.skip_note: Existing opt-in local fixture/signed-in/live-provider suites. Required notification opt-in suites executed separately.

affected_e2e.skip_note: Two production-only fixture guards execute in standard run. New list, signed-in, and all existing bell tests executed.

visual.reference_limits: No E03 desktop mockup; E02 desktop rows/shell and actual sh-notifs phone screen. No separate tradie/state mocks. One-pixel white canvas padding may preserve fractional gallery height.

harness_notes: Initial Node 22.17 module-loader / missing default Chromium selection resolved using Node 22.23.4 and installed Chromium.
First container run omitted Git metadata; existing seed suite could not load. Restored actual checkout metadata and reran the entire suite successfully.
First axe pass caught an invalid label on the loading wrapper. Replaced with existing LoadingRegion; full affected suite then passed.
